items.title: L'Oréal Paris Partners With Shark Tank India To Empower Women Entrepreneurs - Everything Experiential
items.raw_summary: L'Oréal Paris has partnered with Shark Tank India to launch an exclusive early application window for women entrepreneurs, reinforcing its commitment to advancing women's entrepreneurship and expanding access to funding, mentorship and business visibility. According to company announcements and industry reports, the initiative offers aspiring women founders priority access to apply for the upcoming season of the business reality show before applications open to the general public.The exclusive application window will remain open for a limited period in July, allowing shortlisted applicants to progress through the show's selection process and potentially pitch their ventures before the panel of investors. The collaboration aims to encourage greater participation from women-led businesses by lowering barriers to entry and providing access to one of India's most recognised entrepreneurial platforms.Rooted in L'Oréal Paris' long-standing "I'm Worth It" philosophy, the campaign extends the brand's purpose beyond beauty into entrepreneurship. To support the initiative, L'Oréal Paris and Shark Tank India have released a campaign film highlighting the self-doubt, societal expectations and lack of opportunity that often discourage women from pursuing entrepreneurial ambitions, while encouraging more founders to step forward with confidence.The partnership reflects a broader shift in experiential marketing, where brands are increasingly creating platforms that enable participation rather than relying solely on conventional advertising. By offering tangible opportunities alongside brand storytelling, L'Oréal Paris is positioning itself as a facilitator of meaningful consumer engagement and social impact.For the experiential economy, the collaboration demonstrates how entertainment platforms are evolving into ecosystems that connect brands, communities and entrepreneurs through shared experiences. Instead of simply sponsoring content, brands are designing initiatives that create lasting value by enabling participation, fostering inclusion and empowering the next generation of business leaders.

items.title: O plano da Microsoft para auxiliar empresas com a IA
items.raw_summary: A Microsoft apresentou na última quinta-feira, 2, a Microsoft Frontier Company, unidade operacional que irá auxiliar as empresas na integração da inteligência artificial (IA) aos negócios. O negócio tem investimento inicial de US$ 2,5 bilhões e inclui a alocação de 6 mil especialistas em indústria e engenharia. Os profissionais trabalharão junto a clientes como Unilever, Novo Nordisk e Land O’Lakes, cooperativa norte-americana, na seleção e integração das ferramentas tecnológicas. Em postagem no blog da companhia,... O post O plano da Microsoft para auxiliar empresas com a IA apareceu primeiro em Meio e Mensagem - Marketing, Mídia e Comunicação .
items.summary_pt: Microsoft cria unidade (Frontier Company) com US$ 2,5 bi para auxiliar empresas na integração de IA aos negócios.

items.title: Como a fidelização de clientes virou estratégia central das marcas no Brasil - panoramagocomunicacao.com.br
items.raw_summary: O mercado de clubes de benefícios vive uma expansão acelerada, impulsionado pela busca por recorrência de compra e engajamento. Mais do que descontos, os clubes evoluíram para ecossistemas de vantagens e dados, mudando a relação entre marcas e consumidores.
